title: Rainy Hallway Reflection
description: A dimly lit, dilapidated room with rain pouring through a broken skylight. A man in a dark coat stands at a metal desk with a walkie-talkie, steaming cup, and tangled wires, while a large ornate gold frame on the wall shows a surreal infinite hallway with black and white checkered floor.
prompt: A mysterious man in a dark coat stands at a metal desk inside a decaying institutional room, rain pouring heavily through a broken skylight. On the desk are a walkie-talkie with antenna, a steaming paper cup, and tangled wires. A glowing red EXIT sign illuminates the background. A massive ornate gold picture frame hangs on the cracked wall, revealing an endless surreal hallway with black and white checkered floor receding into infinity. Cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere, heavy rain, realistic textures.
